Coram: Hon'Ble Dr. Justice S.N.Pathak For the Petitioners : Mr. A. Allam, Sr. Advocate Ms.
Sushmita Kumari, Advocate Mr. Sumeet Gadodia, Advocate Mrs. Aanya, Advocate Mr. Prakhar,
Advocate Ms. Shruti Shekhar, Advocate For the Resp.-State : Mr. Ashish Kumar Shekhar, Ac to Sc
(L&C)-Ii For the Resp. Nos.7 to 9 : Mr. Anil Kumar, Asgi Mr. Ravi Prakash, Cgc
Gouri Shankar Mahto & Ors vs The State Of Jharkhand & Ors on 6 November, 2023

Learned counsel for the petitioners argues that preliminary notification itself is illegal and dehors the provision of the Act and thus any substituted process of acquisition of land is void ab initio.
Let the respondent nos. 8 & 9 specific reply meeting out the aforesaid contention of learned counsel for the petitioners.
Put up these cases after four weeks.
Till then, the interim order dated 27.07.2023 shall remain in force.
(Dr. S.N. Pathak, J.) Rohit/-
